scientific_review: All192 reconstructed monthly profiles have diagnosed10cm/s crossings. Each calendar month therefore supplies exactly16 year-specific depths, summarized with median, mean, sampled minimum/maximum and explicitly defined linear quartiles. These distributions are distinct from crossings of a mean profile.
Incomplete zero/5cm/s groups retain every year sample and status without reporting a complete-case summary. A missing crossing cannot become a product-limit depth or a partial-sample climatology.

Reconstructed interannual sample spread is not depth confidence bounds, measurement error, actual annual extrema or statistical proof of seasonal variability. Reference-velocity and structural reconstruction errors remain unpropagated.

Five cloud tests cover quantile/range semantics, rejection of biased complete-case summary, censoring, duplicate/mismatched year/month/invalid depths, and complete support in real source profiles. No new raw-field download or local tests.
